instruction: Complete the task in FreeCAD through visible GUI interaction only: inspect the accompanying reference image, create the required single solid with FreeCAD GUI tools, and export the final result. Launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad`. Do not use a terminal, FreeCAD Python console, FreeCADCmd, or an external script to bypass GUI actions. The reference image and the public supplement table are mandatory inputs. The reference image remains the primary source for every numeric dimension shown in it. Before modeling, inspect all views in the reference image and read /home/user/Desktop/supplement.csv. Interpret the orthographic views using the ISO first-angle projection convention shown in the reference image; do not mirror or rearrange views as third-angle projection. The reference image intentionally shows the required numeric dimensions. The supplement table is incomplete and supplies only information omitted from the reference image, such as datum/orientation, feature semantics, missing locations, directions, depths, and connectivity. Do not use it to replace or ignore a numeric dimension shown in the reference image; if a value appears in the reference image, read it directly from the image. Do not rely on the task title or evaluator hints. Read every numeric dimension shown in the reference image directly from the image itself. Use supplement.csv only for parameters intentionally omitted from the reference image, and combine both sources to reconstruct the geometry. Reconstruct the mechanical part named "Single-lug fork bracket". Use millimetres and use the datum/orientation supplied only where the reference image omits it. Preserve the explicit dimensions, holes, openings, steps, and connectivity shown in the reference image. Export only the final valid solid as /home/user/Desktop/result.step. Use only the reference image and supplement.csv as task inputs; do not use evaluator-generated artifacts or evaluator implementation files. The evaluator accepts geometrically equivalent STEP files after import; it does not require byte-identical output or a particular feature order.
